entries.reason: Exiv2 PNG has no EXIF category; ExifTool PNG EXIF (including GPS IFD) is not a both-access pair. Comparator uses XMP/IPTC intersection.
Neither backend lists IPTC-IIM on WebP. Creator/description write-sync drops IIM when StorageDecision omits IPTC-IIM.
Exiv2 MOV/MP4 rows are all-none. Session 28 video is write-ExifTool, read both only where capable; Exiv2 is not a metadata writer or category reader.

Source key sets may omit empty companion tags (no SubSecTimeOriginal / OffsetTimeOriginal). Cross-backend identity compares values, families the reader can see, and classification — not exact SourceRef key sets or SourceRef.backend.

Exiv2 BMFF is read-only (EXIV2_ENABLE_BMFF). Writes go through ExifTool embedded_only or sidecar_recommended; Exiv2 is not a BMFF writer. Session 35 coverage is ExifTool write then both-read where capable.
ExifTool 13.59 does not persist IPTC-IIM in HEIC/HEIF/AVIF/CR3/JXL (IPTC writes leave the file unchanged). Capability rows list iptc as none; write-sync omits IPTC-IIM.

C19 iPhone HEIC container is not synthesizable with pinned ffmpeg (no heif muxer). Session 51 reproduces the EXIF tag layout on jpeg/iphone-heic-layout.jpg; the HEIC file remains Tier B sample heic-quicktime.

GoPro Model and CameraSerialNumber live in the gpmd timed-metadata track on real HERO files. ExifTool does not persist -GoPro:Model= on a synthetic MP4; video/gopro-style.mp4 keeps movie-header dates and UserData LensSerialNumber only. recordingDevice upcast from GoPro tags is unit-tested with assignBase.
C19 Pixel DNG IIM TimeCreated offset versus GPS time is a capture-time sanity check (H21), deferred. datetime_equivalent treats a missing EXIF offset as compatible with the IIM offset.

C19 Pixel JPEG photoshop:DateCreated 4-digit fraction versus EXIF SubSecTimeOriginal 6 digits is not equivalent under datetime_equivalent (zero-padded nanoseconds). H12 shorter-precision compare is not implemented; XMP wins when they disagree. xmp:CreateDate remains unused for dateCreated (C16).
